pluginstrument.author: CAP V-SAR
pluginstrument.description: Four-band precision direction finder (121.5 / 156.8 / 243 / 406.025 MHz) for CAP electronic search training. Includes receiver audio, bearing, spread, signal level, squelch gating, COSPAS/SARSAT decode and the six display pages. Signal propagation is supplied by the CAP V-SAR engine plugin through the cap/df/* datarefs.
